metadata.title: Boiled Chayote squash with Pork | Home recipe
metadata.description:
Most of our food that we consume from from our own backyard, almost everything that we consume is from out garden and fresh, in this recipe I cook meat leftover from the Christmas feast the previous day and boil it with few freshly picked Chayote squash. 

This is a very light and simple recipe devoid of any spices and is good for a simple meal.
